proof_groups.grouping_reason: All three witnesses concern the same function and the same xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg decomposition-and-reassembly boundary. The group has 3 witnesses, below the controller maximum of 12, and keeping them together lets one worker prove and reuse the same focus, segment-fold, and segment-join helper family without cross-group helper dependencies.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: xizi_dll head (prefix ++ pivot :: suffix) entails either the prefix=nil head case or the prefix=prefix0 ++ [prev] case, exposing head links, the prefix segment, prev links, pivot links, and the suffix segment.

head-links ** dllseg first start_prev pivot pivot_prev prefix ** links pivot next pivot_prev ** dllseg next pivot head head_last suffix entails head-links ** dllseg first start_prev head head_last (prefix ++ pivot :: suffix).

proof_groups.proof_strategy: For the entail witness, structurally split prefix into [] or prefix0 ++ [prev], open xizi_dll, expose pivot links and the suffix segment, frame the fresh-node fields, and derive fresh-node distinctness by separation of link fields. For both return witnesses choose the left Coq disjunct, fold linklist_node and linklist into a two-node xizi_dllseg using the supplied nonzero/head inequalities, join that segment to prefix0 when present, retain the sentinel links, and close xizi_dll. Use structural unfolding, sep_apply/cancel/entailer-style reasoning and the allowed duplicate-store inconsistency lemma where needed; do not use any forbidden logical-equivalence or derivable transitivity/commutativity lemma.

per_witness_plan.proof_of_xizi_double_link_insert_before_: Apply the focus helper to xizi_dll head (prefix ++ linklist_pre :: suffix). In the empty-prefix branch instantiate last,next,before_prev,prev as last,next,last,head. In the nonempty branch reuse prefix0,prev,before_prev,first,last,next. Derive linklist_node_pre inequalities from its two fresh field resources being separated from the exposed head/prev/linklist resources, then frame those resources into the selected generated disjunct.

Choose the first disjunct. Substitute prefix = prefix0 ++ [prev]. Fold node and linklist around the existing suffix, prepend prev, join with the prefix0 segment under the retained head links, rewrite list append associativity by simplification, and close xizi_dll.

Choose the first disjunct. Substitute first=linklist_pre, prefix=[], prev=head, and before_prev=last. Fold linklist_node_pre then linklist_pre onto the suffix segment and use the existing sentinel fields as xizi_dll_links head linklist_node_pre last before closing xizi_dll.

premise_discharge.fresh_node_distinctness: The precondition owns both fresh-node fields separately from every exposed list-node/head field; equality would duplicate the same field address, contradicting separation.

premise_discharge.list_equalities: Direct generated hypotheses PreH6 for return_wit_1 and PreH1/PreH7/PreH8/PreH10 for return_wit_2; remaining equations come from empty dllseg simplification and helper existential witnesses.
